title: Yogalates with Lauren
description: 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM · Move, breathe, and energize in this dynamic bilingual class, led by Lauren Norton, designed to uplift your body and mind! Blending the strength and flow of Pilates, the rhythm and energy of dance, and the grounding presence of yoga and breathwork, this session will leave you feeling strong, balanced, and revitalized. Open to all levels, this fun and fast-paced class welcomes everyone looking to build strength, flexibility, and mindfulness in a supportive community space. This class is free, but donations for the instructor are welcome. title: Horror Book Club: Interview with a Vampire
description: 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM · Join us for a spine-tingling afternoon of discussion and seasonal fun. We'll be reading Interview with a Vampire by Anne Rice, which is celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. Here are the confessions of a vampire. Hypnotic, shocking, and chillingly sensual, this is a novel of mesmerizing beauty and astonishing force—a story of danger and flight, of love and loss, of suspense and resolution, and of the extraordinary power of the senses. It is a novel only Anne Rice could write. The event will be led by Crisanne Schworn, a former WPL employee and devoted fan of the horror genre. We will discuss the book while carving pumpkins on the library terrace. Pumpkins and carving tools will be provided. Participants can pick up a free copy of the book starting September 13th at the library front desk after signing up . …
